worktree.setup:
set -euo pipefail

SKIP_ELECTRON_REBUILD=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm env:link
pnpm env:check
pnpm repair:links

mkdir -p ~/.memry
while ! mkdir ~/.memry/native-rebuild.lock 2>/dev/null; do sleep 5; done
pnpm --filter @memry/desktop rebuild:electron
rmdir ~/.memry/native-rebuild.lock

pnpm --filter @memry/editor-web editor:build
worktree.teardown:
set -uo pipefail

for p in 8081 8082 8083 8084 8085; do kill $(lsof -ti :$p) 2>/dev/null || true; done

WT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
for f in ~/.memry/sim-slots/slot-*; do
  [ "$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null)" = "$WT" ] && rm -f "$f"
done

rmdir ~/.memry/native-rebuild.lock 2>/dev/null || true
